title: Unique Pseudo-Expectations for Dynamical $C^*$-Inclusions
summary: Let $(\mathcal{A},G,α)$ be a $C^*$-dynamical system. Unique extension properties for the $C^*$-inclusion $\mathcal{A} \subseteq \mathcal{A} \rtimes_{α,r} G$ have been studied extensively.
